title: Let's Learn English Lesson 44
subtitle: Making Healthy Choices
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 44: Making Healthy Choices (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi there, Ashley!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，阿什莉！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Anna! Hi! Where are you going?
dialogue.zh: 安娜！嗨！你去哪兒？

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: What was that?
dialogue.zh: 那是什麼聲音？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm hungry. When I'm hungry, I only want to eat junk food! But I know I should eat healthy food. So, I fight with myself. One side says, 'You should eat healthy food.' The other side says, 'But I want to eat junk food!'
dialogue.zh: 我餓了。我餓的時候只想吃垃圾食品！可我知道我該吃健康食物。所以我和自己打架。一邊說：‘你應該吃健康食物。’另一邊說：‘可我想吃垃圾食品！’

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Well, Anna, go to the Giant supermarket. You should be able to find all kinds of food there - for all of you.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，安娜，去 Giant 超市。你應該能在那兒找到各種各樣的食物——給你們所有人。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Good idea, Ashley. See you later!
dialogue.zh: 好主意，阿什莉。回頭見！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Bye, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 再見，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wow! This supermarket is huge! Look at all of these fruits and vegetables! I should eat more vegetables.
dialogue.zh: 哇！這家超市好大！看看這些水果和蔬菜！我應該多吃蔬菜。

dialogue.speaker: Healthy
dialogue.en: Good idea, Anna. You must eat more vegetables … like celery!
dialogue.zh: 好主意，安娜。你必須多吃蔬菜……比如芹菜！

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: Celery?! Do you know what the web says about celery?
dialogue.zh: 芹菜？！你知道網上怎麼說芹菜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, what?
dialogue.zh: 不知道，怎麼說？

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: Celery is 95 percent water - 100 percent NOT ice cream. I love the web!
dialogue.zh: 芹菜 95% 是水——100% 不是冰淇淋。我愛網路！

dialogue.speaker: Healthy
dialogue.en: Anna, you mustn't eat junk food. Junk food will kill you.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你千萬別吃垃圾食品。垃圾食品會害了你。

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: You are being silly.
dialogue.zh: 你真傻。

dialogue.speaker: Healthy
dialogue.en: No, you are!
dialogue.zh: 不，你才傻！

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: No, you are.
dialogue.zh: 不，你才是。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Will you two please be nice to each other? It is important to eat healthy foods. But, a little junk food will not kill me. Hmm, ice cream. Ice cream does sound good.
dialogue.zh: 你們兩個能不能對對方好一點？吃健康食物很重要。可是，一點點垃圾食品不會害了我。嗯，冰淇淋。冰淇淋聽起來確實不錯。

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: Take this cart to the frozen food aisle!
dialogue.zh: 把這輛購物車推到冷凍食品區！

dialogue.speaker: Healthy
dialogue.en: No wait, go back! Go back! We forgot fruit. Go back!!
dialogue.zh: 等等，回去！回去！我們忘了水果。回去！！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay, we are in the frozen food aisle!
dialogue.zh: 好，我們到冷凍食品區了！

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: Mmm, ice cream!
dialogue.zh: 嗯，冰淇淋！

dialogue.speaker: Healthy
dialogue.en: Mmm, frozen peas!
dialogue.zh: 嗯，冷凍豌豆！

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: Nobody says, 'Mmm, frozen peas.' They say, 'Mmm, ice cream!'
dialogue.zh: 沒人會說‘嗯，冷凍豌豆’。他們說‘嗯，冰淇淋！’

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am not going to tell you two again! Stop fighting!
dialogue.zh: 我不會再說第二遍了！別吵了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I smell fresh bread! I love the smells of a bakery!
dialogue.zh: 我聞到新鮮麵包了！我愛麵包店的味道！

dialogue.speaker: Healthy
dialogue.en: Oh, Anna, let's buy a fresh loaf of whole wheat, organic bread!
dialogue.zh: 哦，安娜，我們買一條新鮮的全麥有機麵包吧！

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: You don't have to buy bread. Buy some donuts, Anna!
dialogue.zh: 你不必買麵包。買些甜甜圈，安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Healthy
dialogue.en: You mustn't buy donuts. They are only fat and sugar.
dialogue.zh: 你千萬別買甜甜圈。它們只有脂肪和糖。

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: Exactly! You know, you are really no fun at all.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯！你知道嗎，你一點都不好玩。

dialogue.speaker: Healthy
dialogue.en: And you must think having high cholesterol is fun.
dialogue.zh: 那你一定覺得膽固醇高很好玩。

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: Everyone likes donuts! That is why you don't have friends!
dialogue.zh: 人人都喜歡甜甜圈！所以你才沒有朋友！

dialogue.speaker: Healthy
dialogue.en: And that is why your cholesterol is so high!
dialogue.zh: 所以你的膽固醇才那麼高！

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: My cholesterol is none of your business!!
dialogue.zh: 我的膽固醇不關你的事！！

dialogue.speaker: Healthy
dialogue.en: And I have lots of friends!!
dialogue.zh: 而且我有很多朋友！！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Stop it! Stop it! Stop it! I am sick and tired of the both of you!!
dialogue.zh: 停下！停下！停下！我受夠你們兩個了！！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I know what you two need!
dialogue.zh: 我知道你們兩個需要什麼！

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: Anna! What are you doing?
dialogue.zh: 安娜！你在幹什麼？

dialogue.speaker: Healthy
dialogue.en: Put me down!
dialogue.zh: 放下我！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You two need to cool off!
dialogue.zh: 你們兩個需要冷靜一下！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am going to go buy my healthy food and my junk food! Good bye!
dialogue.zh: 我要去買我的健康食物和垃圾食品了！再見！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Until next time …
dialogue.zh: 下次見……

quiz.prompt: Where does Ashley tell Anna to shop?
What does Healthy say Anna must eat more of?
What does Anna buy at the end?
